ns2:course.label: Scenic Design II
ns2:course.description: Advanced problems in scene design for period and style plays and development of professional portfolio. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 undergraduate or 8 graduate hours, if topics vary. Prerequisite: THEA 415 or consent of instructor. Restricted to Theatre majors only.
